zg361_we_m258_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle has_variable = zg361_we_m258_debt_case }
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
			name = zg361_we_m258_expected_debt_id
			value = { value = var:zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle multiply = 1000000 add = { value = var:zg361_we_m258_debt_case multiply = 1000 } add = 258 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_we_m258_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_we_freeze_controllable_scope_258

					has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
				}
				var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		zg361_case_kernel_record_operation_effect = {
			OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner
			SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
			CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
			CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
			STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state
			REVISION_VAR = zg361_case_ac_revision
			ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
			TIMELINE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_timeline_serial
			FEEDBACK_VAR = zg361_case_ac_feedback_revision
			LAST_OPERATION_VAR = zg361_case_ac_last_operation
			LAST_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_last_choice
			RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
			RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
			RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
			RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
			RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
			RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
			TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
			TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
			TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
			TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			TICKET_STATE = 3
			OPERATION_ID = 258
			CHOICE = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_freeze_controllable_scope_258 value = 3 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_operation_used add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_choice value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_type_code value = 258 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 258 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_consumer_contract value = 258 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_business_object_created value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_we_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361we.6258 days = 365 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_write_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_write_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_write_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_write_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_write_state value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_provenance_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_m258_provenance_choice value = 3 }
			zg361_we_m258_consume_effect = yes
			set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 1 }

		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 3
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 3
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 3
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 3
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_total
						has_variable = zg361_we_operation_used
					}
					var:zg361_we_operation_used < var:zg361_we_operation_total
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2583 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED, no receipt or business write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 3
			}
			zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
				RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
				RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
				RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
				RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
				RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
				RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 3
				EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_ac_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_ac_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_ac_active
				EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
				EXPECTED_STATE = 3
			}
			OR = {
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 3
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 3
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_we_m258_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
					EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
					EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
					EXPECTED_STATE = 3
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_last_red_code value = 2589 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 4 } # route collision typed RED
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_we_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
